# Crux

> Crux is an open-source Go CLI that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI) running in tmux sessions with phase-based execution, persistent memory, and verification gates.

## What Crux Does

Crux coordinates multiple AI coding agents working simultaneously on a codebase. It manages them through tmux sessions, assigns tasks via a phase-based workflow system, tracks every decision in a searchable memory system, and enforces verification gates before advancing.

## Key Concepts

- **Phase Engine**: Two-document system (spec + prompt doc) defining what to build and how. Phases have dependencies, file lists, and exit criteria (go build, go test, go vet must pass).
- **Memory System**: Three layers: markdown memory bank for human-readable context, SQLite with FTS5 for structured data, and chromem-go vector index for semantic search over decisions.
- **Agent Plugins**: Each CLI tool implements the AgentPlugin Go interface. Ships with adapters for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and a configurable Generic adapter.
- **Security Model**: Four-tier permissions (readonly, standard, elevated, autonomous), filesystem sandboxing, structured audit logging, and per-agent rate limiting.
- **Orchestrator Loop**: Polls agent tmux panes every 1-2 seconds, updates world state, checks for completed prompts, runs verification gates, and advances phases.
